schemas.benchmark_activity: CREATE TABLE benchmark_activity (id integer primary key, benchmark text, wallet text, timestamp integer, condition_id text, type text, side text, outcome text, outcome_index integer, asset text, size real, price real, usdc_size real, transaction_hash text, title text, slug text, event_slug text, is_combo integer, raw_json text)

schemas.c3_shadow_observations:
CREATE TABLE c3_shadow_observations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    anchor_ts_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hedge_ts_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    delay_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    market_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    direction TEXT NOT NULL,
    btc_price REAL,
    first_ask REAL NOT NULL,
    second_ask REAL NOT NULL,
    first_ask_qty REAL NOT NULL,
    second_ask_qty REAL NOT NULL,
    executable_qty REAL NOT NULL,
    pair_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    gross_edge REAL NOT NULL,
    net_edge_0 REAL NOT NULL,
    net_edge_0025 REAL NOT NULL,
    net_edge_005 REAL NOT NULL,
    net_edge_01 REAL NOT NULL
)
schemas.c3_shadow_observations_v2:
